stem: Which reason has the U.S. government given for supporting Israel?

options.label: A
options.text: Israel provided NATO with the majority of its oil.

options.label: B
options.text: Israel was one of the few democracies in the Middle East.

options.label: C
options.text: Israel fought on the side of the Allied nations during World War II.

options.label: D
options.text: Israel was one of the world’s largest importers of consumer goods.
